items.abstract: We derive an explicit formula for the Bernoulli numbers in terms of Stirling numbers of the second kind. To the best of our knowledge, the formula is new. Additionally, we recover two more explicit formulas from this formula expressing the Bernoulli numbers in terms of Stirling numbers of the second kind.
title: An explicit formula for the Bernoulli numbers in terms of the Stirling numbers of the second kind

items.abstract: In this note, we derive a possibly new explicit formula for the Euler numbers in terms of the Stirling numbers of the second kind.
title: A new explicit formula for the Euler numbers in terms of the Stirling numbers of the second kind

items.abstract: Let $B_{r}$ denote the Bernoulli numbers, and $S(r,k)$ denote the Stirling numbers of the second kind. We prove the following explicit formula $$ B_{r+1}=\sum_{k=0}^{r}\frac{(-1)^{k-1}\, k!\, S(r,k)}{k^2+3k+2}. $$To the best of our knowledge, the formula is new.
title: A new explicit formula for the Bernoulli numbers in terms of the Stirling numbers of the second kind
An explicit formula for Bell numbers in terms of Stirling numbers and hypergeometric functions

items.abstract: We derive an explicit formula for the Bernoulli polynomials in terms of the Stirling numbers of the second kind valid for all non-negative real arguments.
title: An explicit formula for the Bernoulli polynomials in terms of the Stirling numbers of the second kind

items.abstract: In this note, we derive an explicit formula for the Euler zigzag number in terms of Stirling numbers of the second kind.
title: An explicit formula for the Euler zigzag number in terms of Stirling numbers of the second kind

items.abstract: The contour integral is used to construct a very precise explicit equation for determining the number of zeta zeros on the critical line. The resultant expression, as predicted, produces a Heaviside step function, as well as revealing the underlying link to the prime numbers.
title: An Elegant Exact Explicit Formula for Riemann Zeta Zero-Counting Function

items.abstract: Recently, Jha obtained an interesting relation for Bernoulli numbers in terms of Stirling numbers of the second kind. Here we exhibit an alternative deduction of this formula.
title: On a recent formula for Bernoulli numbers involving Stirling numbers
